_README: Ground truth for the classifier, decided once per template.
The bundle ships no labels. These were made by reading one exemplar per
template produced by eval/fingerprint.py - 33 decisions covering all 520
emails - and each row records the exemplar it was decided from, so the
judgement can be checked rather than taken on trust.
THE LABEL FOLLOWS THE BODY. In this corpus subjects and bodies are drawn
independently for operational mail: email_075 is headed 'Time Off Request'
and its body is an RPA billing notice, email_021 is headed '_RPA_ India HSS
SD Billing Process Completed' and asks for shipping instructions. Where the
two disagree the body is the message, because the body is what a person is
being asked to do something about. The strongly-typed templates do not
disagree: all 99 shipping instructions carry an SI subject.
confidence is how sure the reading is, and only rows at 0.90 or above are
used as ground truth. Anything lower is reported as undecided and counts
against coverage rather than against the classifier.
contested marks a label that is a defensible judgement rather than a plain
reading, usually because the taxonomy has two boxes that both fit. Those
rows are scored separately, so a disagreement about a judgement call cannot
be mistaken for a bug - and cannot be quietly used to inflate the score
either.

bad48b7aeb.label: SI_REQUEST
bad48b7aeb.why: The shipping instruction itself, inlined: POL, POD, shipper, consignee, containers, weight. Submitting an instruction is the SI workflow.

3c78e0f39c.label: SI_REQUEST
3c78e0f39c.why: The same instruction template with an FCL line. Same workflow.

b294ccd193.label: SI_REQUEST
b294ccd193.why: 'Please submit SI & AED for all pending shipments by end of day.' A chase for instructions is part of the instruction workflow, not general traffic.

112319d236.label: BL_COMPARISON
112319d236.why: 'Attached are the SI and draft BL ... please check the details and confirm', with both documents attached. The core request this product exists for.

a830c98e49.label: BL_COMPARISON
a830c98e49.why: Instruction and draft bill of lading attached, sent for confirmation.

5a74c65cb3.label: BL_COMPARISON
5a74c65cb3.why: 'Check the draft BL against the SI ... revert with any discrepancy.' The comparison asked for in as many words.

799853247c.label: BL_COMPARISON
799853247c.why: 'Compare the SI and draft BL ... some SI fields were left blank.' A comparison that will escalate is still a comparison.

839a77feb9.label: BL_COMPARISON
839a77feb9.why: 'Compare the SI and draft BL ... (attachments appear to have been dropped).' The request is a comparison; the files went astray in transit.

a1b8184f18.label: BL_COMPARISON
a1b8184f18.why: As above, with the draft named as the missing one.

a62c10f65c.label: BL_COMPARISON
a62c10f65c.why: 'Please find attached the SI and the Commercial Invoice ... confirm the BL is in order.' A check was asked for; the carrier attached the wrong document.

30cbb886ce.label: BL_COMPARISON
30cbb886ce.why: The same, with a Certificate of Origin in place of the bill of lading.

a2b2fd9b41.label: BL_COMPARISON
a2b2fd9b41.why: 'Attached SI and draft BL for checking (scanned copies, image only).' A check that cannot be completed is still a check requested.

5821fe8d60.label: BL_COMPARISON
5821fe8d60.why: As above, with an unopenable file.

eaa960b650.label: INVOICE_QUERY
eaa960b650.why: 'Query on invoice ...: is the THC / local charge included or billed separately?' A charge question about a named invoice.

6de865d0cd.label: INVOICE_QUERY
6de865d0cd.why: 'D&D / detention charges ... confirm the amount before we release payment.' A charge to be agreed before it is paid.

b7ca43a010.label: INVOICE_QUERY
b7ca43a010.why: 'Requesting to cancel invoice ... and reverse the PGI.' An instruction about an invoice.

27a99a0794.label: INVOICE_QUERY
27a99a0794.why: 'The GR is still missing for invoice ... kindly arrange to post the GR so we can proceed with billing.' It names an invoice and it is about billing, which is the invoice box. The case for GENERAL is that the action wanted is a goods receipt posting - an internal operational step - and that nothing about the invoice itself is in question. Contested because both readings are defensible and 23 emails turn on it.

17c1e1f98c.label: GENERAL
17c1e1f98c.why: 'This is an automated notification ... has completed successfully. No action required. -- RPA Bot.' A robot reporting that nothing needs doing. Note the subject on this one reads 'Time Off Request'; the body is the message.

aa8782eb1f.label: GENERAL
aa8782eb1f.why: 'The list of outstanding BL ... action the pending items.' A worklist, not a document check and not an invoice.

f3b59b0c31.label: GENERAL
f3b59b0c31.why: A daily berthing report. Operational traffic.

92ad4c5be8.label: GENERAL
92ad4c5be8.why: 'Update summary for <vessel>. Loading completed, documents to follow.' Operational traffic.

8a6e21c035.label: GENERAL
8a6e21c035.why: A new year greeting and office hours. Nothing to act on.

90ab2516f9.label: GENERAL
90ab2516f9.why: 'Please assist to send the draft BL for <ref> for checking asap.' Nothing has arrived, so there is nothing to compare: the ask is to send, not to check. The case for BL_COMPARISON with a missing attachment is that a check is what the sender ultimately wants. Contested because 91 emails turn on it - the largest single call in the corpus. docs/assumptions.md argues the GENERAL reading from corpus evidence and tests/test_chasers.py pins that evidence; this label agrees with it, and is scored separately so that agreement cannot flatter the headline.
